evidence.reason: The visible line 584 unconditionally materializes and sorts the entire directory listing before comparing it to the small declared set. A directory with many more than MAX_SCAN_ENTRIES children therefore incurs unnecessary allocation and sort cost, and can exhaust resources, before the expected mismatch is returned. The same pattern is reported at line 961. Bounded enumeration with early mismatch is a routine compatible fix, not an owner-level behavior change.
